### The Kind of Love That Carries You
Author: Sarah Frazer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-kind-of-love-that-carries-you-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 1:31
Points:
- Seasons of trial and busyness can leave people feeling like they are running on empty.
- God never expects His children to navigate hardships or heavy loads solely in their own strength.
- Moses reminded Israel that God carried them through the desert just as a loving father carries his son.
- Rather than simply providing guidance from a distance, God personally lifts believers and bears their burdens.
- God’s sustaining love remains steady across every season of life, continuously supplying the strength we lack.

### The Reminder You Need When Life Feels Heavy
Author: Meredith Brock
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-may-27-2026.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 1:31
Points:
- Persistent difficulties and sudden disappointments can quickly lead to exhaustion and discouragement.
- Just as earthly parents carry children who are weary, hurt, or afraid, God invites us into His embrace.
- Believers must resist spiraling into self-reliance and instead allow God’s Word to reorient their thinking.
- When life feels overwhelmingly heavy, God promises to faithfully carry His people the rest of the way.
